summary: Personal-finance lessons aimed at his kids (10 rules): trust no one with your money (LIC policies, blind SIP advice, Bitcoin all-in bets all criticised), diversify across asset classes and geographies, retirement math (3-4% withdrawal, target ~8% USD growth net of tax/inflation), principal protection (India FDs at ~7% pre-tax lose to personal inflation), compounding vs taxation and inflation (need ~9% INR / ~6% USD to stand still), yield/cash-flow assets with liquidity balance (cash-secured puts), loans only when risk/reward >=2-3:1 and exposure capped, legacy planning (Dubai family office), and greed control (single stock <=10% of equity money; debt <=33% of net worth). Calls: none - no investment calls at all.
